capabilities: Render double underscores as underlined text
Apply an underline CSS class in reading mode
Count underscore marks to decide opening and closing pairs
disambiguation: Not a Markdown linter or converter; it only adds an underline rendering for double underscores.
extras: Underlining works only in reading mode, not in editing; there is no hotkey for inserting double underscores, and a closing mark preceded by whitespace can cause the underline to be applied to the next bold element.
intentEvidence: Extends and enhances the markdown syntax.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown has no underline syntax, so text wrapped in double underscores is rendered as bold instead.
summary: Adds an underline syntax to Markdown, rendering double underscores as underlined text in reading mode.
